# nool

> A comprehensive mathematics learning resource from Ontario Tech University providing tutorials, guides, and educational materials for foundational math skills through university-level mathematics.

nool (Ontario Tech University's Online Learning) offers interactive educational content focused on mathematics remediation and skill-building. The platform emphasizes practical applications including healthcare dosage calculations and covers fundamental concepts like fractions, arithmetic, and algebraic operations alongside error prevention guides.

## Key Topics

- Mathematics tutorials
- Basic math skills
- Fractions and fraction operations
- BEDMAS order of operations
- Arithmetic fundamentals
- Common math mistakes
- Algebra
- Trigonometry
- Dosage calculations
- Number sense
- Decimal and percent
- Polynomial expansion
- Negative numbers
- Square roots
- Complex numbers

## Core Mathematics Hubs

- [Mathematics](https://nool.ontariotechu.ca/mathematics/index.php): Main mathematics section hub for prerequisite material and university math review
- [Basic Math Skills and Number Sense](https://nool.ontariotechu.ca/mathematics/basic/index.php): Landing page for basic math skills, fractions, decimals, and dosage calculations
- [Fractions](https://nool.ontariotechu.ca/mathematics/basic/fractions/index.php): Comprehensive fractions hub covering operations and arithmetic

## Common Math Mistakes & Error Prevention

- [Avoiding Common Math Mistakes](https://nool.ontariotechu.ca/mathematics/math-mistakes/index.php): Guide to avoiding common math errors in algebra, trigonometry, and arithmetic
- [Avoiding Common Math Mistakes - Expanding](https://nool.ontariotechu.ca/mathematics/math-mistakes/avoiding-common-math-mistakes-expanding.php): Tutorial on avoiding mistakes when expanding polynomial expressions
- [Avoiding Common Math Mistakes - Trigonometry](https://nool.ontariotechu.ca/mathematics/math-mistakes/avoiding-common-math-mistakes-trigonometry.php): Guide to common trigonometry errors and how to avoid them
- [Avoiding Common Math Mistakes - Simplifying](https://nool.ontariotechu.ca/mathematics/math-mistakes/avoiding-common-math-mistakes-simplifiying.php): Tutorial on avoiding errors when simplifying algebraic expressions
- [Avoiding Common Math Mistakes - Square Roots](https://nool.ontariotechu.ca/mathematics/math-mistakes/avoiding-common-math-mistakes-square-roots.php): Guide to common square root calculation errors and solutions
- [Avoiding Common Math Mistakes - Working with Negatives](https://nool.ontariotechu.ca/mathematics/math-mistakes/avoiding-common-math-mistakes-working-with-negatives.php): Tutorial on avoiding errors with negative number arithmetic

## Fraction Operations & Techniques

- [Adding and Subtracting Fractions](https://nool.ontariotechu.ca/mathematics/basic/fractions/adding-and-subtracting-fractions.php): Tutorial on adding and subtracting fractions with examples
- [Multiplying and Dividing Fractions](https://nool.ontariotechu.ca/mathematics/basic/fractions/multiplying-and-dividing.php): Tutorial on multiplying and dividing fraction operations
- [BEDMAS with Fractions](https://nool.ontariotechu.ca/mathematics/basic/fractions/bedmas-with-fractions.php): Guide to applying BEDMAS order of operations with fractions

## Applied Mathematics & Practical Topics

- [Dosage Calculations](https://nool.ontariotechu.ca/mathematics/basic/dosage-calculations.php): Healthcare math guide for pharmaceutical dosage calculations
- [Decimal and Percent](https://nool.ontariotechu.ca/mathematics/basic/decimal-and-percent.php): Guide to decimal conversion and percent calculations for beginners
- [Dilutions](https://nool.ontariotechu.ca/mathematics/basic/Dilutions and Solution Preparation1.php): Educational resource on dilutions and solution preparation chemistry

## Arithmetic & Number Fundamentals

- [Long Division](https://nool.ontariotechu.ca/mathematics/basic/long-division.php): Guide to long division algorithm for elementary mathematics skills
- [Long Multiplication with Large Numbers](https://nool.ontariotechu.ca/mathematics/basic/long-multiplication.php): Tutorial on long multiplication method for large numbers
- [Factorial](https://nool.ontariotechu.ca/mathematics/basic/factorial.php): Educational resource on factorial calculations and number sense

## Advanced Topics

- [Complex Numbers](https://nool.ontariotechu.ca/mathematics/basic/complex-numbers.php): Tutorial on complex numbers and algebra fundamentals
- [Circles](https://nool.ontariotechu.ca/mathematics/basic/circles.php): Educational resource on circle geometry and properties
